protocol.prediction: free autoregression; initial real history only; no future-observation refresh
protocol.reference: per-query per-candidate per-horizon mean true latent across equally weighted hidden conditions
protocol.aggregation: average condition/candidate/time energies within query, sum across queries, normalize per checkpoint, then mean over matching training repetitions
protocol.negative_scores: retained; score has maximum100 and no finite minimum; not a percentage accuracy

bootstrap.unit: source cluster shared across all conditions/candidates and training repetitions; source episode or mirrored-scene family when known, otherwise query
bootstrap.scope: source-sampling uncertainty conditional on the evaluated checkpoints; training repetitions are not resampled

protocol.score_space: each checkpoint native frozen evaluation representation
protocol.scope: registered test candidate-action panels; per-task source coverage is reported below
protocol.error_diagnostics: real-input predictions use privileged future observations; error at every depth is normalized by the same all-horizon target-mean energy; free-minus-real is a sensitivity contrast, not an additive causal decomposition
